title: NIS2 Implementing Regulation (EU) 2024/2690, Annex, to Grundschutz++
description: The technical and methodological requirements in the Annex of Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2024/2690, which apply to DNS service providers, TLD name registries, cloud computing, data centre and content delivery network providers, managed service and managed security service providers, online marketplaces, online search engines, social networking platforms and trust service providers. One source per numbered heading (subsection, or section where it has none), as in ENISA's mapping table. The step to ISO/IEC 27001:2022 is ENISA's, from the mapping table of its NIS2 Technical Implementation Guidance (CC BY 4.0, © European Union Agency for Cybersecurity), read and checked by tools/enisa-iso.mjs; the Grundschutz++ targets of those Annex A controls come from the BSI's own mapping. ISO clauses that ENISA names are recorded in the remarks; they have no Annex A control and give no target. Direct targets are taken over from the Art. 21(2) draft where ENISA names only clauses for the core of a point. Status draft: no person has reviewed the mapping yet. For entities outside the regulation's scope, Art. 21(2) (preset nis2) is the source.

maps.remarks: Konzept für die Sicherheit von Netz- und Informationssystemen (Anhang Nr. 1.1). ENISA also names ISO 27001 clauses 5.2, 9.3: management-system clauses without an Annex A control, so no derived target.
Rollen, Verantwortlichkeiten und Weisungsbefugnisse (Anhang Nr. 1.2). ENISA also names ISO 27001 clause 5.3: a management-system clause without an Annex A control, so no derived target.

Risikomanagementrahmen (Anhang Nr. 2.1). ENISA also names ISO 27001 clauses 6.1, 6.1.2, 6.1.3, 6.2, 8.2, 8.3: management-system clauses without an Annex A control, so no derived target. Risk analysis itself is ISO clause 6.1, not Annex A; its targets are taken over as direct targets from the Art. 21(2)(a) draft (mappings/src/nis2.json).
Überwachung der Einhaltung (Anhang Nr. 2.2). ENISA also names ISO 27001 clause 9.2: a management-system clause without an Annex A control, so no derived target.

Änderungsmanagement, Reparatur und Wartung (Anhang Nr. 6.4). ENISA also names ISO 27001 clauses 6.3, 8.1: management-system clauses without an Annex A control, so no derived target.
Sicherheitsprüfung (Anhang Nr. 6.5).

Konzepte und Verfahren zur Bewertung der Wirksamkeit von Risikomanagementmaßnahmen im Bereich der Cybersicherheit (Artikel 21 Absatz 2 Buchstabe f der Richtlinie (EU) 2022/2555) (Anhang Nr. 7). ENISA also names ISO 27001 clauses 6.2, 9.1, 9.3: management-system clauses without an Annex A control, so no derived target. ENISA names no Annex A control here; the direct targets are taken over from the Art. 21(2)(f) draft (mappings/src/nis2.json).
